newsitem.title: USA: US W.Coast gasolines ease with supply, light trade.
newsitem.headline: US W.Coast gasolines ease with supply, light trade.

text.p: U.S. West Coast spot unleaded gasoline markets eased Monday, as ample supply and little buying interest forced sellers to drop offers, traders said.
Trade was quiet, as refiners figured out their needs after a social function kept many out of markets last week.
West Coast markets are normally quiet Mondays because players want to see weekly inventory data, issued the following evening by the American Petroleum Institute (API).
